name: hc595
title: 74HC595 shift register
notes: Eight outputs from a serial input: SER, SRCLK and RCLK, with OE for the brightness of all. QH' goes to SER of the next chip, so a chain of any length takes the same lines.
A high input takes 3.15 V at a supply of 4.5 V and more at 5 V: fed from 3.3 V it takes the outputs of any chip of 3.3 V.

facts.source: TI SN54HC595, SN74HC595, SCLS041J, October 2021: 8-bit serial-in parallel-out, QH' for cascading, VCC 2 to 6 V, VIH 3.15 V at VCC 4.5 V
